title: AutoPromote!
description: Auto send messages in chat to promote links!
body:
This plugin auto promotes a link or any thing that you want to remind your server about. To edit the message go to config.yml and edit the message you can also edit the interval in minuits and disable it. 

Default/Example placholder::

```
broadcast:
  message: '&c&l<&o(Edit in config.yml which is inside plugins/AutoPromote!)&r&c&l>
  &l&e Support the server by going to:&r&l&b https://ko-fi.com/zackdcat'
  interval-mins: 1
  enabled: false
```


**It is reccomended to use & sybols instead of the paper colour changing properties.**

If there is a version that does not exist please email me here so i know to add it: zwhseton@gmail.com
